title: euclidean distance cached
explanation:
### Description

Compute Euclidean distance transform using cached Saito algorithm.

**input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkImageActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageActor.html) — image actor.
- [vtkImageCast](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageCast.html) — image cast.
- [vtkImageEuclideanDistance](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageEuclideanDistance.html) — image euclidean distance.
- [vtkImageThreshold](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageThreshold.html) — thresholds an image, replacing values inside/outside a range.
- [vtkPNGReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPNGReader.html) — png reader.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
